_note: Client Desk settings per care-home client. Non-secret system ids and Surven's own copy only: no names of people, no phone numbers, no email addresses. The location id, Joey's alert contact and the AGC field ids also live in config/surven.json; this file adds what only the Client Desk needs. A pipeline or calendar with id null is found by name at run time (match words, case-insensitive); fallback_id is used only when no name matches.
